---
name: Behavior report / 行为问题
about: Report a concrete failure in questioning, judgment or research synthesis
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## Request and context / 请求与必要上下文

Use a fictionalized or permitted example. Remove unpublished research, private
data, personal names and credentials before posting.

## Actual response / 实际回答

Include the relevant preceding answer when reporting a follow-up failure.

## Expected behavior / 预期行为

Explain what decision was affected: unsupported agreement, forced opposition,
invented facts, disconnected questions, premature closure, ignored stop request, etc.

## Environment / 使用环境

Agent/model, date, skill revision and mode. State which source materials were
actually available to the agent.
